name: rickshawi
description: ركشتي — تطبيق طلب الركشات في السودان

scripts.sync: npm run libs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease
scripts.serve: npm run libs && npx http-server www -p 8080 -c-1
